execution_statement: No live search was executed as of 2026-11-15 (protocol registration date). This file is the pre-registered corpus ledger: it carries only the protocol's registered seed set (sok_review_protocol.md section 1) resolved against the real literature registry, labeled role and planned screening status. It asserts no corpus size, no observed screening counts, and no retrieval date; per-stage counts in the protocol remain zero and labeled planned. The executed retrieval ledger must be produced by the registered search (five databases x five strings S1-S5) plus snowballing before any entry moves beyond screening_status PLANNED.

screening_status_vocabulary.INCLUDED: record passed full-text screening S4 (dual-coded) and retained in the frozen corpus
screening_status_vocabulary.EXCLUDED: record failed a screening stage with a logged reason code (protocol section 3)
screening_status_vocabulary.PLANNED: record registered for screening but not yet screened; no live search has been executed

role_vocabulary.transparency: verifiable-log evidence class (presence-in-log vs processing/execution boundary)
role_vocabulary.attestation: remote-attestation / TEE evidence taxonomy (normative anchor or claim source)
role_vocabulary.capability: context-bound authority and authorization-time evidence (purpose/replay families)
role_vocabulary.agent-tool-use: tool-using agent benchmark observability categories (baseline B2)
role_vocabulary.evidence-boundary: record fixing an explicit claim-evidence boundary the lattice separates

seed_note: The protocol registers W3C PROV-DM (baseline B1 source) as a seed, but the shared literature registry contains no PROV-DM record; only the matrix's in-project B1 port row cites it. Per the no-invented-ids rule, no PROV-DM entry is created here. The registry gap is recorded as an unresolved dependency for the executed retrieval ledger, which must add the record through a logged search channel, not by hand.
dedup_rule: Exact DOI match first; otherwise normalized title plus first-author surname plus year (protocol section 4.4). All eight seeds below are mutually distinct under this rule: no duplicates detected, no merge logged.

entries.title: Remote ATtestation procedureS (RATS) Architecture
entries.sok_role_detail: Baseline B0 source (blueprint): normative attester/evidence/verifier evidence taxonomy; the claim-boundary anchor the SoK lattice must exceed with new cases, never rebrand. Registry class: standard, not A* paper.

entries.title: Certificate Transparency Version 2.0
entries.sok_role_detail: Transparency evidence-class anchor (gap G1/G6): verifiable-log inclusion supports presence-in-log, never processing or execution proof. Registry class: standard, not A* paper.

entries.title: Macaroons: Cookies with Contextual Caveats for Decentralized Authorization in the Cloud
entries.sok_role_detail: Authority-scoping comparator (gap G4/G8, purpose_scope/replay families): caveat-bound authorization evidence says nothing about execution or semantic consumption. Registry class: peer-reviewed NDSS 2014 paper (out-of-window canonical version kept under protocol section 3 duplicate semantics; in-window status to be re-verified at screening).

entries.title: Zanzibar: Google’s Consistent, Global Authorization System
entries.sok_role_detail: Verification-time consistency boundary comparator (gap G5, revocation_timing family): a permission valid at evaluation time is a different evidence class from a provider-attested receipt or execution trace. Registry class: peer-reviewed USENIX ATC 2019 paper.

entries.title: AgentDojo: A Dynamic Environment to Evaluate Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses for LLM Agents
entries.sok_role_detail: Baseline B2 source (blueprint): attack-robustness benchmark whose observability categories (in-loop observer, instruction-compliance oracle) the coverage matrix codes as published claims; the SoK runs no attacks. Registry class: peer-reviewed NeurIPS 2024 D&B track.

entries.title: ToolEmu: Identifying the Risks of LM Agents with an LM-Emulated Sandbox
entries.sok_role_detail: Baseline B2 source (blueprint): LM-emulated sandbox evidence living entirely below lattice level L2 (simulation evidence, judge-assigned labels), separating emulated outcomes from attested execution. Registry class: peer-reviewed ICLR 2024 paper.

entries.title: tau-bench: A Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction in Real-World Domains
entries.sok_role_detail: Harness-outcome evidence comparator (gap G3, L4 boundary): final database-state checks by an in-loop evaluator bound harness-internal evidence but justify no claim above L1. Registry class: A* ML (peer-reviewed ICLR 2025).

entries.title: FHIR R5 Consent, AuditEvent, Provenance resources
entries.sok_role_detail: Baseline B1 companion: retrospective consent/audit/provenance lineage vocabulary; records who-what-when attribution without verifying it (lineage-vs-attestation boundary, novelty contract F2). Registry class: standard.
